tell: A mechlorethamine derivative whose two active metabolites circulate at one-tenth and one-hundredth of the parent's plasma levels.

clues.text: Protein binding is 94 to 96%, and the drug is mainly cleared by hydrolysis, with about 50% of an intravenous dose recovered in urine.
A hydrochloride salt of molecular weight 394.7, with an active moiety of 358.3; its lyophilized powder form is sterile and non-pyrogenic.
Approved under an NDA as an injection solution and as a lyophilized powder for injection, given on days 1 and 2 of each cycle.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to the drug, and nausea and fatigue are the most frequent reactions around infusion.
Chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and indolent B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that progressed soon after rituximab.
Forms covalent bonds that create interstrand DNA crosslinks, and is active against both quiescent and dividing cells.
The generic name begins with B and has twelve letters.
